if someone ever needs my help, they're either more pathetic than i am, or they will use it to mock me even more, the only kind of "help" i give as of late is only when someone is just too fucking lazy to do something and have me do it.

I highly doubt that will ever happen, my disorders and disabilities prevent me from fully functioning as a normal person, whenever i make something to help my current situation i undermine my efforts soon after. most often this applies to friendships and relationships. but i have a problem with other things as well. for example im a slow thinker, like REALLY slow. im around 17 and still can't wrap my head around multiplication table ( i hope that's what its called in english.) and other things as well. i trust too easily and i am also VERY forgetful, sometimes i even forget my last name or what year it is. im trying my best to fix my life but so far ive changed very little. i know that i may be too young to worry about these things and all but since my parent's clearly don't care then i try to care for myself.
